semanticAnalysis.sprintSummary: This sprint is overwhelmingly focused on content creation, marketing, and sales support activities, not software engineering. The primary goals appear to be producing a demo video, learning YouTube channel management, and building a simple automation to support video creation. Core product development is minimal.

problematicTasks.title: Save Assets to Google Drive
issues: This is a trivial administrative action, not a unit of engineering work.
Logging such tasks inflates velocity metrics and obscures real engineering progress.

problematicTasks.title: Write Video Script
issues: This is a content creation/marketing task, not a software engineering task.
The entire sequence from #2130 to #2134 represents a non-technical workflow that should be tracked outside of an engineering sprint.

problematicTasks.title: Learn YouTube Studio
issues: This is a training task, not a development task that delivers sprint value.
While learning is important, it should not be tracked as a primary deliverable with the same weight as feature development.

problematicTasks.title: Generate Real-World Use Case from Approved Proposal
issues: This is a business analysis or product management function, not an engineering implementation task.
This duplicates effort seen in the previous sprint (e.g., #2128, #2121).

duplicateOrOverlapping.reason: These are all sequential, micro-managed steps for a single deliverable: 'Produce and publish a demo video'. They should be consolidated into one, or at most two, non-engineering tasks.
These are all sub-tasks of a single learning objective: 'Research and learn YouTube channel management'. They are too granular and represent a single effort.

unclearWork.title: Generate AI Video Using Avatar Character
unclearWork.problem: It is unclear if this involves engineering work (e.g., building a tool or API integration) or simply using an off-the-shelf video creation product. If it's the latter, it's a content creation task, not engineering.

unclearWork.title: Merge AI-Generated Video Segments into a Single Final Video within n8n
unclearWork.problem: While this appears to be a valid automation task, its value is entirely dependent on a non-engineering content creation process. The engineering effort should be clearly separated from the content it's processing to evaluate its standalone technical merit.

strengths: #2167: 'Add Workflow Tracking, Logging, and Error Handling' is a well-defined, valuable engineering task that improves system robustness.

The technical work assigned to Anam Saleem (e.g., #2162, #2167, #2168) is generally better defined as engineering effort compared to the other tasks in the sprint.
